ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 30% high-intensity white pixels distributed as discrete clusters against a 70% low-intensity black surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Multiple circular high-intensity blobs dispersed across both lobes; a high-density concentration of contiguous white pixels is visible in the medial region of the left lobe, while the right lobe contains more discrete, isolated spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression at the center; the vertex angle is approximately 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serrations along the continuous linear boundary of both lobes; peaks and valleys occur at approximately 10-15 pixel intervals.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the upper trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive global detection of circular ring-like pixel clusters (ranging 5-15 pixels in diameter) across both lobes, primarily high-contrast white rings against the dark ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the peduncle and lower central region of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of circular barnacle scars and parallel linear rake marks concentrated in the medial and basal regions of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense 'leopard-style' pattern formed by the high-contrast circular rosette scarring.
